experiments.name: flags to rd chain
experiments.command: ./bench --method slope --unroll 20000 --unroll2 40000 --iters 100 --warmup 10 --reps 10 --init 'li.d $r12, 5; li.d $r13, 7; li.d $r14, 9; li.d $r15, 11; armmtflag $r12, 0xff' --asm 'armmtflag $r12, 0xff; armmove $r12, $r13, 14'

latencies.notes: ARMFLAGS -> rd: the move is conditional, so it consumes the condition flags; the chain closes through `armmtflag` writing them from rd and the measured 4.00 cycles less the 2-cycle flag move give 2. The instruction does not write ARMFLAGS: with distinct registers two copies take 2.00 cycles, so they do not serialise on the flag register, and an earlier `rd -> ARMFLAGS` entry was wrong.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: armmove $r12, $r4, 14; armmove $r13, $r5, 14; armmove $r14, $r6, 14; armmove $r15, $r7, 14; armmove $r16, $r8, 14; armmove $r17, $r9, 14; armmove $r18, $r10, 14; armmove $r19, $r11, 14
throughput.init: addi.d $r4, $r0, 1; addi.d $r5, $r0, 2; addi.d $r6, $r0, 3; addi.d $r7, $r0, 4; addi.d $r8, $r0, 5; addi.d $r9, $r0, 6; addi.d $r10, $r0, 7; addi.d $r11, $r0, 8; armmtflag $r0, 0x39
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 10 --init 'addi.d $r4, $r0, 1; addi.d $r5, $r0, 2; addi.d $r6, $r0, 3; addi.d $r7, $r0, 4; addi.d $r8, $r0, 5; addi.d $r9, $r0, 6; addi.d $r10, $r0, 7; addi.d $r11, $r0, 8; armmtflag $r0, 0x39' --asm 'armmove $r12, $r4, 14; armmove $r13, $r5, 14; armmove $r14, $r6, 14; armmove $r15, $r7, 14; armmove $r16, $r8, 14; armmove $r17, $r9, 14; armmove $r18, $r10, 14; armmove $r19, $r11, 14'
throughput.notes: 8 independent lanes take 8.00 cycles, i.e. 1 CPI. The instruction is a single uop; its conditional execution limits it to one per two cycles (armmfflag and armmove are not conditional on register data and run at one per cycle). Re-measured on 2026-11-17 on LA664, core 0, with --method slope (--unroll 250 --unroll2 1000) and confirmed with the 0x01 uop counter.

notes: LBT ARM-style instruction. Conditional move: it reads ARMFLAGS as the condition and does not write them. Latency is recorded for each source operand: rd -> rd (2), rk -> rd (2) and ARMFLAGS -> rd (2).
